channel.title: Violations Watch: Palestine (Gaza)
channel.description: New incidents reported in Palestine (Gaza). Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Israeli ground operation and strikes in central Gaza and Gaza City on 18 Nov kill three to four Palestinians, including an 11-year-old boy; families flee Nuseirat (Reuters, Al Jazeera, Anadolu, local medical sources)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Nuseirat, Palestine (Gaza). Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. Reported casualties: 3-4 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Gaza Health Ministry reports seven killed over the preceding 24 hours; Israel says the operation targets militants; child casualty reported via Drop Site citing local sources. 4 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1168
